name: ModelVariant791_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant791_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a volley of bolts flies from a model point to the opposing slot and a second volley to the ground around it, each wrapped in sprite rings and Gouraud strips, trailing ribbons and smoke and flaring into glows, sparks and a shock fan on arrival while the light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the bolt rings, puffs, rays, sparks and shock fan and packs five texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 4 on each frame after the first bolt arrives, 1 once when the last bolt arrives, 2 after the last glow fades and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-808 and 905 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
